1. Architectural Overview & Design Philosophy

Retiam includes a native, hardware-accelerated **WebGPU Path Tracing and Monte Carlo Global Illumination** subsystem. Unlike typical WebGL engines that restrict rendering to rasterization, Retiam integrates a full Two-Level Acceleration Structure (TLAS / BLAS), custom GPU memory arenas, Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS), Next Event Estimation (NEE), and neural denoiser integration (Intel Open Image Denoise - OIDN) running entirely on WebGPU compute shaders.

blocks.text: 2. Acceleration Structures & BVH Construction
The raytracing core is implemented across:

items: [`src/engine/render/raytrace/BVHBuilder.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/render/raytrace/BVHBuilder.ts)
[`src/engine/render/raytrace/GPUArena.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/render/raytrace/GPUArena.ts)
[`src/engine/render/raytrace/RaytraceManager.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/render/raytrace/RaytraceManager.ts)

blocks.text: Bottom-Level Acceleration Structure (BLAS)
Each 3D mesh is converted into an array of triangles:

items: **Triangle format**: 3 vertices $(p_0, p_1, p_2)$, 3 normals $(n_0, n_1, n_2)$, and 3 UV coordinates $(uv_0, uv_1, uv_2)$.

children: **Binned Surface Area Heuristic (SAH)**: Divides bounding boxes into spatial bins along the longest axis, evaluating surface area traversal cost:

blocks.tex: C = C_{\text{trav}} + \frac{S_A}{S} \cdot N_A \cdot C_{\text{isect}} + \frac{S_B}{S} \cdot N_B \cdot C_{\text{isect}}

items: **Spatial Median Split**: Fallback splitting when primitive count is below a threshold or SAH yields no split advantage.
**Node Flattening**: The hierarchical tree is serialized into a flat array of 32-byte GPU-friendly nodes:

blocks.text: Dynamic Morph Mesh Refitting

For morphing geometries ([`MorphGeometry.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/components/geometry/MorphGeometry.ts)), recomputing a full BVH from scratch every frame is computationally prohibitive. Retiam builds a base BVH on the midpoint topology between Mesh A and Mesh B once, and performs **GPU-accelerated or bottom-up AABB refitting**:

items: The tree hierarchy remains topologically static.
Leaf bounding boxes are dynamically updated from interpolated vertices.
Internal nodes propagate union bounding boxes from leaves up to the root in $O(N)$ time.

blocks.text: Top-Level Acceleration Structure (TLAS)
The TLAS aggregates all active world-space entities:

items: Evaluates world-transformed bounding boxes for each entity.
Builds a top-level BVH over entity root nodes.
Ray traversal on the GPU traverses the TLAS first; once an entity leaf is hit, the ray is transformed into the object's local space to traverse the BLAS.

blocks.text: 3. GPU Memory Arena (GPUArena.ts)
WebGPU requires buffers to be allocated with explicit sizes. Rather than allocating individual buffers per mesh or triangle, Retiam implements **dynamic growing GPU memory arenas**:
Stride & Allocation Layout

cells.text: World matrix, invWorld matrix, material properties (albedo, roughness, metallic, emissive, IOR)
AABB min (vec3 + count), AABB max (vec3 + rightChild)
Light-emitting triangles for Multiple Importance Sampling

blocks.text: When the primitive count exceeds the current arena size, `ensureCapacity` doubles the buffer size, copies existing data, and signals pipeline bind groups to rebind.
4. Path Tracing Kernel & Multiple Importance Sampling
The path tracing shader is defined in [`src/engine/render/raytrace/RaytraceShaders.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/render/raytrace/RaytraceShaders.ts).
Monte Carlo Integration & BRDFs
The path tracer simulates physical transport via the rendering equation:

blocks.tex: L_o(p, \omega_o) = L_e(p, \omega_o) + \int_{\Omega} f_r(p, \omega_i, \omega_o) L_i(p, \omega_i) (\omega_i \cdot n) d\omega_i

blocks.text: Retiam evaluates:

items: **Cook-Torrance Microfacet Specular BRDF**:

blocks.tex: f_r = \frac{D(h) F(\omega_o, h) G(\omega_i, \omega_o, h)}{4 (\omega_i \cdot n) (\omega_o \cdot n)}

items: $D$: GGX / Trowbridge-Reitz normal distribution.
$F$: Schlick's approximation for Fresnel reflectance.
$G$: Smith's separable shadowing-masking function.
**Lambertian Diffuse BRDF**:

blocks.text: Multiple Importance Sampling (MIS)
To eliminate fireflies and converge quickly in complex scenes with small bright emitters:

items: **BRDF Sampling**: Rays are cosine-weighted or GGX-importance sampled.
**Light Emitter Sampling (Next Event Estimation - NEE)**: Direct rays are explicitly cast towards triangles in `emitterArena`.
The power heuristic balances the two sampling strategies:

blocks.text: Progressive Temporal Accumulation
Monte Carlo path tracing relies on temporal sample accumulation across frames:

items: **Ping-Pong Textures**: Two `rgba32float` textures (`accumTexA` and `accumTexB`) are swapped each frame.
**Running Average**:
**Camera Invalidation**: If camera position, orientation, or FOV changes, `RaytraceManager.resetAccumulation()` resets $N = 0$.

blocks.text: 5. Denoising Pipeline
To enable real-time interactive previews and fast video exports without needing thousands of samples per pixel, Retiam provides two denoising options:
A. Spatial Edge-Preserving Denoise (SpatialDenoisePass.ts)

items: Implemented as a lightweight WebGPU compute pass.
Computes an adaptive cross-bilateral filter utilizing surface normals and depth:

blocks.tex: W(i, j) = \exp\left(-\frac{\|p_i - p_j\|^2}{2\sigma_x^2}\right) \exp\left(-\frac{|d_i - d_j|^2}{2\sigma_d^2}\right) \max(0, n_i \cdot n_j)^{\gamma}

items: Throttles or bypasses compute when accumulated frames exceed 200 (where convergence has naturally smoothed the signal).

blocks.text: B. Intel Open Image Denoise (OIDN) Integration (OIDNDenoisePass.ts)

items: Retiam packages the Intel OIDN pre-trained UNet model weights (`rt_hdr_alb_nrm.tza`).

items.text: Executes a deep learning denoising inference pass on WebGPU compute buffers:
children: Inputs: Noisy Color (`rgba32float`), Auxiliary Albedo (`rgba16float`), Auxiliary Normals (`rgba16float`).
Output: High-fidelity reconstructed HDR color with zero high-frequency grain.

blocks.text: 6. FrameGraph Integration & Render Passes
Raytracing integrates into Retiam's declarative FrameGraph via three passes:

items: **`RaytraceGBufferPass`**: Generates full-resolution primary ray hit position, normal, albedo, and depth targets.
**`RaytracePass`**: Executes recursive path tracing bounces and temporal sample accumulation.
Applies gamma correction ($\gamma = 2.2$).
Merges raytraced 3D depths with rasterized 2D overlays into the final swapchain render pass.
